frozen_guarantees: Primitive-family facts enter through RegistrationBundle data.
Opaque IDs prevent public enum growth per family.
Evidence validation state and provenance remain first-class.
PASS and FAIL paths can coexist; disabled-by-evidence entries are retained but not active.
Duplicate IDs/policy keys and broken references are rejected atomically.
The frozen Phase 2 package API v1 is reference compatibility only and is not extended for new families.

scaling_rule.add_new_family: provide a structurally valid registration bundle with evidence/provenance

current_limit: Registry representation is generic; selection policy execution is not yet registry-driven.
